support: train EXCEPTION images (10/category), disjoint from test 15 anomalies
calibration: 20 normals/category; zero-label policies use all 20 for the threshold, few-shot policies use 10 fit / 10 threshold
transfer_control: global model sees only six seen categories; no new-category labels
historical_exposure: the nine categories were not scored by v3.1 local PatchCore/CLIP, but results/mvtec_ad_surface.json already lists all 15 AD categories in a prior surface experiment; all 225 held-out test images overlap that prior run exactly. This is a v3.1-pipeline holdout, not an organizationally blind holdout.
fewshot: 1/2/5/10 labeled anomaly corrections per new category; 3 seeds
metric_learning: PCA32 + NCA(8) on CLIP RN50 embeddings, 1-NN; CPU only
caveat: MVTec AD categories are distinct objects; image-level split, no physical unit IDs
